fields.description: Used as the submitting device for calls that aren't tied to one branch, e.g. item sync. Must be an Active branch under this company.
fields.label: Default Branch (for company-wide submissions)

fields.description: From the app created on the GavaConnect developer portal (developer.go.ke) and subscribed to eTIMS OSCU. Every call to KRA needs them.
fields.label: GavaConnect App Credentials

fields.description: The app's Apigee App ID from GavaConnect > My Apps. It is not the Consumer Key.
fields.label: Apigee App ID

fields.description: Point-of-sale, payment collected immediately - the direct match to a KRA fiscal receipt.
fields.label: Sign POS Invoices (receipts)

fields.description: Off by default - credit invoices raise separate compliance questions (timing, amendments) not yet resolved. Turn on deliberately.
fields.label: Sign Sales Invoices (credit/general)

fields.description: Send stock in/out (purchases, sales with stock, stock entries, reconciliations) to KRA. KRA rejects a sale for an item it has no stock record for.
fields.label: Sync Stock Movements
Item Defaults
fields.description: Used by Register All Items with KRA for an item that doesn't have its own value. A value on the item always wins.

fields.label: Default VAT Band
fields.description: For an item with no Item Tax Template. B = VAT 16%.

fields.label: Default KRA Product Category
fields.description: For an item whose Item Group (or a parent group) has no KRA Product Category. Set categories on Item Groups for accuracy.
What KRA prints on the fiscal receipt, separate from the invoice lines.
fields.label: Receipt Branding

fields.description: Printed on the KRA receipt. KRA allows at most 20 characters; defaults to the Company name, cut to 20.
fields.label: Trade Name

fields.description: Shown as the receipt's address (adrs) when the invoice itself has no Company Address set. Leave blank to send an empty address in that case rather than guess one.
fields.label: Fallback Address

fields.description: Printed above the itemized list on KRA-signed receipts (topMsg), e.g. a welcome message.
fields.label: Receipt Header Message

fields.description: Printed at the bottom of KRA-signed receipts (btmMsg), e.g. a thank-you or return-policy note.
fields.label: Receipt Footer Message
